title.en: Warm, knowledgeable care across the whole team

text.en: Reviewers consistently praise every layer of the practice — receptionists, vet techs, and doctors — for kindness, patience, and thoroughness. Dr. Greco, Dr. Canales, and Dr. Bradshaw are highlighted by name for their attentiveness and genuine concern. Long-term clients spanning fifteen years report never having a bad experience across multiple vets at this practice.

title.en: Thorough exams with sound clinical judgment

text.en: Owners highlight that vets take time to address every concern and develop clear treatment plans. Dr. Greco is specifically praised for coming up with immediate solutions after a thorough exam. The practice has successfully managed dental surgeries, ongoing conditions, and complex cases, earning deep trust from clients who travel from other neighborhoods.

title.en: Last-minute slots available; one responsiveness issue

text.en: Several owners mention being able to book same-day or very short-notice appointments — a major selling point for urgent pet health needs. Reviewers describe visits as unhurried, with vets spending ample time on concerns. One long-term client noted recent difficulty getting timely responses for international travel health certificate documentation.

q.en: How easy is it to get a last-minute appointment?

a.en: Reviewers say same-day or next-day slots are frequently available due to the size of the practice and number of vets on staff.

q.en: Does West Chelsea Veterinary handle dental procedures?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers mention dental surgeries with positive outcomes and careful monitoring throughout.
Yes, many reviewers bring cats and describe attentive, cat-friendly care across multiple visits.

q.en: Can the clinic assist with travel health certificates?

a.en: One long-term client recently noted difficulty getting timely responses for travel documentation; contacting the clinic directly in advance is advisable.
